## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-erc8004-reader`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-erc8004-reader -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `erc8004_agents.jsonl`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `README.md`
- `probes.json`
- `manifest.jsonl`

# ERC-8004 reader

DISCOVERED — reader facts from the ERC-8004 Identity registry (CREATE2 `0x8004a169fb4a3325136eb29fa0ceb6d2e539a432`, live on mainnets): registrations read via keyless public RPC (`eth_call tokenURI`), declared service endpoints probed three-state for liveness. Nothing minted, no transactions ever, Validation mainnet PENDING. The live board is `GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc`. [![GSPC](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcouncilof.ai%2Fapi%2Fgspc&query=%24.totals.public_count&label=GSPC&color=0B1F33)](https://councilof.ai/gspc-scoreboard)

**The headline: we measured the REAL agents, not the registry noise.** The 8004scan
indexer reports ~785,000 registrations. Filtered to agents that have actually received
on-chain feedback (`min_feedbacks>=1`), that drops to **138,967**. We drew a defensible
sample of that real population, resolved each agent's on-chain `tokenURI(uint256)` keylessly,
decoded the registration-v1 descriptor, and probed its declared service endpoint three-state.

## Live-filter result (`erc8004_live_filter_census.json`)

- **45 real agents probed** (ranked from the feedback-bearing + x402 pool, on chains with a
  keyless public RPC so every selected agent was actually probed).
- **25 LIVE / 14 PLACEHOLDER / 6 DEAD → live-fraction 0.556.** Roughly **half** of the real
  agents have a genuinely reachable service; the other half are placeholders or dead endpoints.
- `LIVE` = declared endpoint answers HTTP 2xx/3xx (or 401/402/403 auth-gated) ·
  `PLACEHOLDER` = registration resolves + declares an endpoint but it answers 4xx/5xx ·
  `DEAD` = no endpoint declared, or DNS/connection fails.

## Files

- `erc8004_agents.jsonl` — flat viewer table, one row per probed identity (45): `agent_id`,
  `token_id`, `name`, `chain_id`, `endpoint_state` (LIVE/PLACEHOLDER/DEAD), `registry_address`,
  `http_status`, `as_of`. Registry totals stay in `erc8004_live_filter_census.json`.
- `erc8004_live_filter_census.json` — the full 45-agent probe: per-row chain, token_id,
  tokenURI sha256, declared endpoint, three-state, HTTP code; plus registry totals.
- `erc8004_live_atoms.json` — the 25 genuinely-LIVE agents (the callable set).
- `ledger-card-erc8004-callable-unsigned.json` — the `erc8004.callable` card-v0 atom
  (aggregate census summary; `sig_ed25519=null` — NO_LAPTOP_SIGN, queued for GHA OIDC signing
  under `did:web:csoai.org#board-attestation-1`).
- `census_snapshot.json`, `tokenuris.json`, `probes.json` — the earlier n=3 snapshot, retained.

## What this is not

- Not a GSPC axis. No GSPC measure fields on any card.
- Not 785k minted identities — we registered nothing and never will from a ledger script.
- Not a Validation-registry result — Validation mainnet is PENDING; testnet skipped.
- `is_verified` filter returns the full set unchanged (indexer quirk) — treated as untrusted.
- High-feedback agents on chains without a keyless RPC (e.g. 5042002, 196) were logged
  UNRESOLVED, never counted as DEAD.

**Measurement, not certification.** Verify a card (free, no account): https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify
